message.content:
A red magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large black letters features the sub-text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Below, the title "GO DAI" appears in white, with a green icon of a seated person holding a book with signal waves above their head integrated between the words. A sub-headline reads "BERDAKWAH LEWAT MEDIA SOSIAL, SEJUMLAH USTAD MUDA MERAIH KETENARAN. BISNIS SYIAR DI ERA DIGITAL."

In the foreground, a dark silhouette of a hand holds a black smartphone vertically. The phone's screen is red and contains several small, white human figures in traditional clothing walking to the right. More identical figures are scattered across the red background outside the phone. All these figures wear white robes and headgear, including turbans, caps, and headscarves. They appear to be walking in the same direction, with some partially cut off by the phone's edges. At the top, two smaller headlines state "JALAN BUNTU PENGUSUTAN KORUPSI HELI TNI" and "OTAK-ATIK UU PERTAMBANGAN". A barcode and publication details for June 2018 are at the bottom left.
